column1: # Pins one photo to one configuration, for references the sheet lists more than once.
# "variant" must match the sheet's "Variant / Name" cell (folded to lowercase and
# hyphens, so punctuation and spacing don't matter). "filename" is a file already
# skips the row if it isn't.
# A listing on a shared reference with no row here shows NO photo and drops to the
# enquiry list. That is deliberate: showing another variant's dial is worse.
# Every pin below was set by opening the image and matching it to the variant.
# GMT-Master II — the pairs differ only by bracelet. Note vtnr is ordered the
# opposite way round to blnr/grnr, so these are not derivable from file order.
# Photos present but matching NO listing we carry, and listings with no photo:
#   336933/2 champagne on Jubilee (dup dial)  ·  336933 "Black Dial" has no photo
#   126334/3,/4 rhodium WITH diamond markers — our "Grey Rhodium" row implies plain,
#     and rows that do carry stones say so ("MOP Diamond"), so left unpinned
#   126503/1  white dial      — our only pale listing is "Champagne Dial"; not the same colour
#   126505/2  black + diamond dots  ·  126505/3 sundust w/ baton (listing wants baguette)
# Unmatched listings: 126505 Chocolate, Sundust Baguette · 126508 John Mayer, Pikachu
